command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 16, release region unstretched (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 50)

metrics.arm: P_rel: P_nsz's flags + --tnear; target term retrained, object term reused from <cond>_nsz; seeds 10-12; builds full, nobottle, noplate and the S3 creations
metrics.layer2_go: pp_l2's mapping, unchanged (S1 as restated; S2 3F + OM in both layouts; S3 ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6, both atoms, both layouts, k in {1, 5, 10})
metrics.metric: k5_arr_new: K5's new-layout arrival given hold (arrived / held, seeds pooled); P_rel - P_nsz, 2,000-draw state bootstrap (pp_round_read.py --tag r16 --metric k5_arr_new --ref-s2 pp_r15_roll:P2nsz)
metrics.reported_no_verdict: K5 new success and place on arrival; arrival given hold per compound and layout vs P_nsz; familiar non-regression vs P_nsz ('regresses' iff CI upper bound < 0); per-pairing 3F; each target part's fitted rho
metrics.round_verdict: improves iff delta > 0.10 and the CI lower bound > 0
metrics.s1_restated: S1 holds iff, with every target part's m fixed to v for each v in the inventory, both swap tests and every target-into-grasp component are exactly 0 for every seed
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds
metrics.written_before: the round's S1 read and any of its rollouts
